channels.title: Notification channels
channels.name: Name

telegramHowTo.title: How to get the chat ID
telegramHowTo.step1: Open our notification bot in Telegram and send it any message (the bot itself is configured on the server).
telegramHowTo.step2: Get your chat ID: send a message to {'@'}userinfobot, or open the bot getUpdates page and copy chat.id.
telegramHowTo.step3: Paste the number here. For a group, add the bot to the group; the group ID starts with a minus.

channels.webhookHint: After creation you will get a signing secret to verify the HMAC signature of requests. It is shown once.
channels.emptyText: Add a channel to get notified about regressions, SLO breaches and failed runs.
channels.signingSecretText: Save it now: it is shown only once and is needed to verify the X-LoadWatch-Signature header.
